_seo.titolo: LA MAISON GROUP | Short-term rental management and real estate investment
_seo.descrizione: LA MAISON GROUP: acquisition, enhancement and management of income-producing properties. Short-term and long-term rentals, sales and real estate consulting in Northern Italy. Free valuation.

invito_finale.testo_1: Tell us about your home: we will tell you what it is worth and suggest the most profitable route between short-term rental, long-term rental and sale. Free and with no obligation.

servizi.foto_1_alt: Furnished living room of a short-term rental apartment
servizi.testo_1: Listings, pricing, guests and paperwork: we handle it all. You choose the plan and collect the income, worry-free.
servizi.foto_2_alt: Interior of an apartment available for long-term rent
servizi.testo_2: We find a reliable tenant, draw up the contract and manage the lease: a steady income, with no surprises.
servizi.foto_3_alt: Façade of a modern house for sale
servizi.testo_3: Valuation, marketing, negotiation and closing: we guide you step by step all the way to the signature.

servizi.testo_4: Want to invest, or make more from what you already own? We analyse the numbers and show you the right strategy.

perche_sceglierci.testo_1: Short-term rentals, long-term rentals, sales and consulting: one partner for everything, with direct access to the owners of the company.
perche_sceglierci.testo_2: We buy and renovate properties for ourselves too: every piece of advice comes from real numbers and hands-on experience.
perche_sceglierci.testo_3: Contracts, registrations, permits and formalities: we take care of them from start to finish, always compliant.
perche_sceglierci.testo_4: Selling, renting or investing: we analyse your property and propose the most profitable route, not a one-size-fits-all one.

dove_operiamo.testo_1: We personally manage properties in the provinces highlighted on the map. Is your property somewhere else? Get in touch: we consider every request.
